baseline_parameters.interpretation: Values come from stored nominal/oracle evaluations. The oracle defines parameter truth inside the fitting family; omitted mismatch forces remain absent. Fixed zero-delay bound hits are not estimated-parameter pinning. The CSV lists every retained seed/group; fixed baselines have no optimization-start variation.

recorded_cpu_runtime.scope: Recorded command wall time; immutable cached fits may be reused. This is not an uncached runtime measurement when reused fits are present.

detail_location: Source provenance IDs, confidence intervals, objective traces, per-trajectory p95 errors, and initialization sensitivity are resolved in full_summary; unavailable outcomes are never discarded.
generator_reference_semantics: Stored clean observations include generator delay and mismatch; finite-sample noise reference, not a strict lower bound.
oracle_semantics: Truth physics and true delay inside fitting family; omitted force absent under mismatch.
selection_policy: Finite training objective only, including nonconvergence; exact ties in S0/S1/S2 order.
